description: This file defines the interface for the Rialto control component, including the IControl and IControlFactory classes, which provide methods for creating control instances and registering clients for control operations. It also includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: IControlFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IControl.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface defining control operations such as client registration.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new IControlClient and provides the current application state.
